subject: planner: fix leading hint cannot take effect in UNION ALL statements (#50277)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff vs first parent focusing on planner hint plumbing and join reorder usage. The change makes `PlanBuilder.tableHintInfo` a pointer stack (`[]*TableHintInfo`) and returns stable pointers via `TableHints()`, preventing hintInfo aliasing/overwrite across multiple SELECTs in a `UNION ALL` (where join nodes keep `LogicalJoin.hintInfo` pointers for later join-reorder). Warning collection was updated accordingly (`CollectUnmatchedHintWarnings` now takes a pointer). Added/updated tests and golden outputs reflect the intended behavior change. No remaining Blocker/High correctness, semantic, concurrency, or session/privilege issues identified in the touched planner logic; later upstream history shows further refactors/fixes around leading hints but no revert indicating a regression here.
